verdict.rationale: Intuit publishes official SDKs in its own GitHub org. These include a PHP client for the QuickBooks Online V3 REST API with create, read, update and delete examples, and a Node.js OAuth 2.0 client. The Node.js client handles token management and refresh, parses QuickBooks Fault errors, and documents a sandbox/production switch for building against isolated test data. missing for 10: evidence of official SDKs beyond PHP (the Node.js package covers only OAuth, not the full API), a published OpenAPI spec for generating clients (probes returned 404), and independent or hands-on corroboration of SDK quality.
